title: One Thai film, one emotional thesis
avoid_when: approved trailer or poster media is unavailable
source_contract: Use an official trailer or owner-approved film media for a private editorial POC
Keep a landscape film window rather than destructive portrait cropping
creative_contract: Contradict the title or expectation in the hook
Show how ordinary moments change that motive
Generate narration before selecting final shots
Keep captions to one phrase and at most seven words
qa_contract: Full playback plus start, quarter, middle, three-quarter, and end samples
CRV, black/freeze, loudness, codec, and dimension checks
Verify each shot supports the current spoken beat
hard_rejections: voice unrelated to the visible shot

notes: Treat the story shape as the recipe; do not copy the film-specific words
Use the original project as a visual comparison baseline

proof.disposition: Owner accepted the revised single-film story as not bad
proof.qa: Accepted baseline project includes full review and QA artifacts
